messages.text: Morning all. Pulling pipeline numbers for Brian's 10am. I have 23 deals in active pipeline, about $41.6M total committed volume. Can everyone confirm their stage updates in LoanOrigination before 9:30?
Credit memos: 9 in analysis, 6 waiting on financials from borrowers. Two of those are over 10 days stale, I'll flag them in the sheet.
I've got 6 on my side, roughly $12.4M. Two should hit underwriting this week. {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0057}} is the biggest, a term loan upsize on the existing facility.
For {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0057}}, I still need the updated debt schedule and the interim P&L. Can't clear underwriting without them. Realistic submit is Monday.
Understood, chasing the client's CFO this morning. I'll push the stage to 'Docs Pending' so it doesn't inflate the underwriting count.
Closing side: 4 loans scheduled to fund by end of month, ~$7.8M. One slipped because the title work isn't back. Will update the forecast tab.
Which one slipped? If it's the one I'm thinking of, that moves us under the monthly funding target by a bit. Need to know before I talk to Martin.
It's {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0046}}, the refinance. Title company says Tuesday at the earliest, so it likely funds first week of September. Rest are on track.

Heads up, CreditScoring reran overnight and a couple of scores shifted. {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0197}} moved from a 'pass' to a 'refer' on the revised model. Josh, do you want to look at it before it goes in the pipeline totals?
Yes, send me the memo draft. A refer isn't a decline, but I want to see what drove the change. Probably the updated cash flow ratio.
Updated total: 22 deals, $39.9M after moving the refinance out of the month-end bucket and parking {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0197}} as 'under review'. Sheet is refreshed.
Thanks Lynn. Month-end funded forecast is the number I care about. Anyone see upside beyond the 4 closings?
Possibly one small one, about $1.1M, if the borrower signs the commitment letter by Friday. I'd call it 50/50, so I'd leave it out of the base case.
Agreed, keep it out of the base case. Let's list it as upside only. Great work everyone, see you at 10.
FYI {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0086}}'s application is complete and in my queue. Should have the memo to Josh by end of day tomorrow.
